custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxiness' of the cake surfaces. Real fondant has subtle imperfections; AI often makes it look like plastic. Also, check if the reflections on the glass match the implied light sources. The 'basket' cake's handle is a high-risk area for fusion artifacts.
